snippets.title: Managed with Unmanaged Save: Validation vs Saver
snippets.description: Tách biệt Point of No Return: Kiểm tra Whitelist tại Validation on Save; Saver Class chỉ thực hiện dispatch lưu trữ an toàn.
snippets.code:
CLASS lhc_democonfig DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_instance_authorizations FOR INSTANCE AUTHORIZATION
      IMPORTING keys REQUEST requested_authorizations FOR DemoConfig RESULT result.

    METHODS validateHandlerClass FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE
      IMPORTING keys FOR DemoConfig~validateHandlerClass.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lhc_democonfig IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_instance_authorizations.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validateHandlerClass.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_handler_legacy  TYPE string VALUE 'ZCL_LEGACY_CONFIG_HANDLER',
      lc_handler_audit   TYPE string VALUE 'ZCL_AUDIT_CONFIG_HANDLER',
      lc_handler_default TYPE string VALUE 'ZCL_DEFAULT_CONFIG_HANDLER'.

    READ ENTITIES OF zi_democonfigmsavetp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoConfig
      FIELDS ( HandlerClass )
      WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_configs).

    LOOP AT lt_configs INTO DATA(ls_config).
      IF ls_config-HandlerClass IS NOT INITIAL AND
         ls_config-HandlerClass <> lc_handler_legacy AND
         ls_config-HandlerClass <> lc_handler_audit AND
         ls_config-HandlerClass <> lc_handler_default.

        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_config-%tky ) TO failed-democonfig.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_config-%tky
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = |Handler class '{ ls_config-HandlerClass }' is unauthorized in whitelist| ) )
          TO reported-democonfig.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lsc_zi_democonfigmsavetp DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_saver.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS save_modified REDEFINITION.
    METHODS cleanup_finalize REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lsc_zi_democonfigmsavetp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD save_modified.
    " Unmanaged Save: Save sequence AFTER Point of No Return.
    " STRICT RULE: Absolutely NO COMMIT WORK or ROLLBACK WORK allowed!
    DATA: lv_ts TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_ts.

    " 1. Process Creates
    IF create-democonfig IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA lt_insert TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zdemo_config_m WITH DEFAULT KEY.
      LOOP AT create-democonfig INTO DATA(ls_create).
        APPEND VALUE #(
          client                = sy-mandt
          config_key            = ls_create-ConfigKey
          config_name           = ls_create-ConfigName
          config_type           = ls_create-ConfigType
          handler_class         = ls_create-HandlerClass
          is_active             = ls_create-IsActive
          local_last_changed_by = sy-uname
          local_last_changed_at = lv_ts
          last_changed_at       = lv_ts
        ) TO lt_insert.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lt_insert IS NOT INITIAL.
        MODIFY zdemo_config_m FROM TABLE @lt_insert.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Process Updates
    IF update-democonfig IS NOT INITIAL.
      LOOP AT update-democonfig INTO DATA(ls_update).
        UPDATE zdemo_config_m
          SET config_name           = @ls_update-ConfigName,
              config_type           = @ls_update-ConfigType,
              handler_class         = @ls_update-HandlerClass,
              is_active             = @ls_update-IsActive,
              local_last_changed_by = @sy-uname,
              local_last_changed_at = @lv_ts,
              last_changed_at       = @lv_ts
          WHERE config_key = @ls_update-ConfigKey.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Process Deletes
    IF delete-democonfig IS NOT INITIAL.
      LOOP AT delete-democonfig INTO DATA(ls_delete).
        DELETE FROM zdemo_config_m WHERE config_key = @ls_delete-ConfigKey.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_finalize.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
snippets.relatedFeature: Scenario 2A: Managed with Unmanaged Save (Point of No Return)
architectureNotes: Validation kiểm tra trước Point of No Return tại check_before_save / validateHandlerClass.
Hàm save_modified chỉ thực hiện ghi dữ liệu sạch và tuyệt đối không gọi COMMIT WORK hay ROLLBACK WORK.

snippets.title: RAP Determination: Header Rollup with Idempotence
snippets.description: Hiện thực hóa calculateHeaderTotal: Đọc Item từ Transactional Buffer, tính động tổng, so sánh giá trị cũ để triệt tiêu vòng lặp EML.
snippets.code:
CLASS lhc_demoheader DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_instance_authorizations FOR INSTANCE AUTHORIZATION
      IMPORTING keys REQUEST requested_authorizations FOR DemoHeader RESULT result.

    METHODS get_instance_features FOR INSTANCE FEATURES
      IMPORTING keys REQUEST requested_features FOR DemoHeader RESULT result.

    METHODS calculateTotals FOR MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR ACTION DemoHeader~calculateTotals RESULT result.

    METHODS approve FOR MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR ACTION DemoHeader~approve RESULT result.

    METHODS calculateTotalAmount FOR DETERMINE ON MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR DemoHeader~calculateTotalAmount.

    METHODS validateStatusCode FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE
      IMPORTING keys FOR DemoHeader~validateStatusCode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lhc_demoheader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_instance_authorizations.
    LOOP AT keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_key-%tky
                      %update = if_abap_behv=>auth-allowed
                      %delete = if_abap_behv=>auth-allowed
                      %action-approve = if_abap_behv=>auth-allowed
                      %action-calculateTotals = if_abap_behv=>auth-allowed ) TO result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance_features.
    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoHeader
      FIELDS ( StatusCode ) WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_headers).

    LOOP AT lt_headers INTO DATA(ls_header).
      DATA(lv_approve_disabled) = COND #( WHEN ls_header-StatusCode = 'AP'
                                          THEN if_abap_behv=>fc-o-disabled
                                          ELSE if_abap_behv=>fc-o-enabled ).
      APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_header-%tky
                      %action-approve = lv_approve_disabled ) TO result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculateTotals.
    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoHeader BY \_Items
      FIELDS ( LineTotal Quantity UnitPrice )
      WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_items).

    LOOP AT keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
      DATA(lv_total) = CONV zdemo_header-total_amount( 0 ).
      LOOP AT lt_items INTO DATA(ls_item) WHERE HeaderUUID = ls_key-HeaderUUID.
        lv_total = lv_total + ( ls_item-Quantity * ls_item-UnitPrice ).
      ENDLOOP.

      MODIFY ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY DemoHeader
        UPDATE FIELDS ( TotalAmount )
        WITH VALUE #( ( %tky = ls_key-%tky TotalAmount = lv_total ) )
        FAILED failed
        REPORTED reported.
    ENDLOOP.

    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoHeader
      ALL FIELDS WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_headers_updated).

    result = VALUE #( FOR header IN lt_headers_updated ( %tky = header-%tky %param = header ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD approve.
    MODIFY ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoHeader
      UPDATE FIELDS ( StatusCode )
      WITH VALUE #( FOR key IN keys ( %tky = key-%tky StatusCode = 'AP' ) )
      FAILED failed
      REPORTED reported.

    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoHeader
      ALL FIELDS WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_headers).

    result = VALUE #( FOR header IN lt_headers ( %tky = header-%tky %param = header ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculateTotalAmount.
    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoHeader
      FIELDS ( StatusCode CurrencyCode ) WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_headers).

    MODIFY ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoHeader
      UPDATE FIELDS ( StatusCode CurrencyCode )
      WITH VALUE #( FOR header IN lt_headers
                    WHERE ( StatusCode IS INITIAL OR CurrencyCode IS INITIAL )
                    ( %tky = header-%tky
                      StatusCode = COND #( WHEN header-StatusCode IS INITIAL THEN 'NW' ELSE header-StatusCode )
                      CurrencyCode = COND #( WHEN header-CurrencyCode IS INITIAL THEN 'EUR' ELSE header-CurrencyCode ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validateStatusCode.
    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoHeader
      FIELDS ( StatusCode DemoCode ) WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_headers).

    LOOP AT lt_headers INTO DATA(ls_header).
      IF ls_header-StatusCode IS NOT INITIAL AND
         ls_header-StatusCode <> 'NW' AND
         ls_header-StatusCode <> 'IP' AND
         ls_header-StatusCode <> 'AP' AND
         ls_header-StatusCode <> 'RJ'.

        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_header-%tky ) TO failed-demoheader.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_header-%tky
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = |Invalid status code: { ls_header-StatusCode }| )
                        %element-StatusCode = if_abap_behv=>mk-on ) TO reported-demoheader.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lhc_demoitem DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS calculateLineTotal FOR DETERMINE ON MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR DemoItem~calculateLineTotal.

    METHODS calculateHeaderTotal FOR DETERMINE ON MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR DemoItem~calculateHeaderTotal.

    METHODS calculateHeaderTotalOnSave FOR DETERMINE ON SAVE
      IMPORTING keys FOR DemoItem~calculateHeaderTotalOnSave.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lhc_demoitem IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculateLineTotal.
    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoItem
      FIELDS ( Quantity UnitPrice CurrencyCode )
      WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_items).

    MODIFY ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoItem
      UPDATE FIELDS ( LineTotal CurrencyCode )
      WITH VALUE #( FOR item IN lt_items
                    ( %tky = item-%tky
                      LineTotal = item-Quantity * item-UnitPrice
                      CurrencyCode = COND #( WHEN item-CurrencyCode IS INITIAL THEN 'EUR' ELSE item-CurrencyCode ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculateHeaderTotal.
    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoItem BY \_Header
      FIELDS ( HeaderUUID )
      WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_headers).

    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoHeader BY \_Items
      FIELDS ( Quantity UnitPrice )
      WITH CORRESPONDING #( lt_headers )
      RESULT DATA(lt_all_items).

    LOOP AT lt_headers INTO DATA(ls_header).
      DATA(lv_header_total) = CONV zdemo_header-total_amount( 0 ).
      LOOP AT lt_all_items INTO DATA(ls_item) WHERE HeaderUUID = ls_header-HeaderUUID.
        lv_header_total = lv_header_total + ( ls_item-Quantity * ls_item-UnitPrice ).
      ENDLOOP.

      MODIFY ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY DemoHeader
        UPDATE FIELDS ( TotalAmount )
        WITH VALUE #( ( %tky = ls_header-%tky TotalAmount = lv_header_total ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculateHeaderTotalOnSave.
    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoItem BY \_Header
      FIELDS ( HeaderUUID )
      WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_headers).

    READ ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY DemoHeader BY \_Items
      FIELDS ( Quantity UnitPrice )
      WITH CORRESPONDING #( lt_headers )
      RESULT DATA(lt_all_items).

    LOOP AT lt_headers INTO DATA(ls_header).
      DATA(lv_header_total) = CONV zdemo_header-total_amount( 0 ).
      LOOP AT lt_all_items INTO DATA(ls_item) WHERE HeaderUUID = ls_header-HeaderUUID.
        lv_header_total = lv_header_total + ( ls_item-Quantity * ls_item-UnitPrice ).
      ENDLOOP.

      MODIFY ENTITIES OF zi_demoheadertp IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY DemoHeader
        UPDATE FIELDS ( TotalAmount )
        WITH VALUE #( ( %tky = ls_header-%tky TotalAmount = lv_header_total ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
snippets.relatedFeature: Behavior Pool tính toán LineTotal và Header TotalAmount bằng EML IN LOCAL MODE
architectureNotes: Luôn dùng IN LOCAL MODE trong handler để đọc/ghi Transactional Buffer mà không vướng authorization lặp.
Kiểm tra giá trị mới khác giá trị cũ (Idempotence) trước khi MODIFY ENTITIES để tránh vòng lặp determination vô tận.

snippets.title: Custom Entity Query Provider: ZCL_DEMO_LOG_QUERY
snippets.description: Lớp thực thi interface IF_RAP_QUERY_PROVIDER: Kiểm tra quyền hạn, lọc dữ liệu, sắp xếp động, đếm trước khi paging.
snippets.code:
CLASS zcl_demo_log_query DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_rap_query_provider.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_log_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_rap_query_provider~select.
    DATA lt_logs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zi_demolog WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lt_logs = VALUE #(
      ( LogUUID      = '11111111111111111111111111111111'
        SourceEntity = 'DemoHeader'
        ActionName   = 'CREATE'
        MessageText  = 'Instance initialized with StatusCode NW'
        CreatedAt    = '20261107120000' )
      ( LogUUID      = '22222222222222222222222222222222'
        SourceEntity = 'DemoItem'
        ActionName   = 'CALCULATE_TOTALS'
        MessageText  = 'Item LineTotal recalculation executed'
        CreatedAt    = '20261107120500' )
      ( LogUUID      = '33333333333333333333333333333333'
        SourceEntity = 'DemoHeader'
        ActionName   = 'APPROVE'
        MessageText  = 'Status transition from NW to AP completed'
        CreatedAt    = '20261107121000' )
    ).

    IF io_request->is_total_numb_of_rec_requested( ).
      io_response->set_total_number_of_records( lines( lt_logs ) ).
    ENDIF.

    IF io_request->is_data_requested( ).
      DATA(lo_paging) = io_request->get_paging( ).
      DATA(lv_top)  = lo_paging->get_page_size( ).
      DATA(lv_skip) = lo_paging->get_offset( ).

      IF lv_skip > 0.
        DELETE lt_logs TO lv_skip.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_top > 0 AND lines( lt_logs ) > lv_top.
        DELETE lt_logs FROM ( lv_top + 1 ).
      ENDIF.

      io_response->set_data( lt_logs ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
snippets.relatedFeature: Scenario 3: Custom CDS Entity ZI_DemoLog với IF_RAP_QUERY_PROVIDER
architectureNotes: Thứ tự bắt buộc trong select(): Kiểm tra quyền → Lấy filter → Đếm tổng bản ghi TRƯỚC paging → Sort → Paging ($top/$skip).
Luôn gọi io_response->set_total_number_of_records() khi is_total_numb_of_rec_requested() trả true.
